title: Make Company B PowerShell test decoding deterministic
objective: Make the Python subprocess helper used by Company B PowerShell runtime tests decode PowerShell output deterministically on Windows, including user profiles with non-ASCII paths. This is a test-harness-only change.
acceptance_criteria: The shared PowerShell subprocess helper must explicitly decode captured stdout and stderr as UTF-8 instead of relying on the Windows locale encoding.
Malformed output bytes must remain diagnostically visible without crashing the subprocess reader thread.
Do not weaken return-code assertions, skip behavior, timeouts, or any Company B safety contract test.
Do not modify production scripts, documentation, scheduler, heartbeat, Company A files, or trading code.
Final independent Codex review must return PASS.
